bandReport.notes: WARNING FOR THE MAIN SESSION: the RIGHT column of page 10 (p10.png, and the end of the PDF text layer for page 10) carries the retyper's printed answer KEY for all 100 items (a 'Key' grid of Q. NO. / ANSWER), followed by an institute advert. It is not a question; not transcribed, not used. The blind pass must not be given p10.png or p10-c2.png whole. Column split: c1 and c2 overlap by ~85 px; no text was cut on pages 8-10. Region fractions are of the whole page (c2 starts at x=865 of 1870). No stray fragments were found in this band. Items split across pages: Q83 (stem + gland table on p8 right column, options on p9 left column top); Q95 (stem + A, B on p9, C, D on p10). Retyping errors / as-printed oddities, all kept verbatim: Q75 'Adiantium' (for Adiantum). Q78 'Dr. Vasantrao Govarikar' (usual spelling Gowariker). Q74 options table (pasted scan) prints 'Barium - 140' in (A), 'Barium -140' in (B)/(C) and 'Bariumn -140' in (D); 'Music Systems' capitalised in (A) only. Q81 statement (3) 'RINA' (presumably RNA) and grammar 'GM crops being produced'; option (C) '2, 3, 5' cites a statement 5 although only four statements are printed. Q83 table 'Overy' (for Ovary); table headings 'gland', 'hormone' lower-case as printed. Q84 'RBC:100' no space as printed. Q86 grammar 'has a structure like inter connected tubes, conduct water...' as printed. Q88 stem is INCOMPLETE: it ends 'select correct order of' with nothing after (the rest of the sentence was lost in the retype); the Venn figure is a scan and labels 'Camivores' (scan rendering of Carnivores). Q89 'fresh water ecosystems' as printed. Q90 stem wraps oddly ('X, Y,' / 'Z, W.'), collapsed. Q94 'Mysure' (for Mysuru/Mysore), 'Vishakha Pattanam'. Q95 'Barnoulli's principle' (for Bernoulli's). Q96 grammar 'In which of the following state of India have maximum number' as printed. Q98 'Chandrayan-3' as printed. Q99 'Aditya L-l' (letter l for digit 1, both in image and text layer) and option (C) 'PSL.V - C 52' (stray full stop). Image and text layer agree on all of these. Classification notes: Q100 'Golden Revolution' has no catalog home; used Biology / Agriculture and Animal Husbandry with soft subtopic 'Agricultural Revolutions' (suggest a subtopic of that name). Q88 used Ecosystem and Environment with soft subtopic 'Components of an Ecosystem' (suggest adding it). Q92 (cyclone naming) filed under General Science / Science and Technology in the News / Current Events; Disaster Management / Weather and Climate Agencies would also fit.
